body:
Maria Ops: Heads up  inbound FRA drop (26 A100s) arrived paperwork incomplete. Vendor flagged 3 units DOA and 2 as serial mismatch at QC. AWB: NS-EU-223344. Can we partial-release the healthy units and triage the rest?
Jordan SCM: Contract SLA = 5 bd replacement. Vendor offering 48h express for +€3,200. Loaner pool check?
Elena (NordShip): NordShip confirming AWB NS-EU-223344: 21 clear + 5 flagged. Flagged serials DOA: A100-F9001, A100-F9002, A100-F9003. Serial mismatch: A100-F9004 (label/serial mismatch), A100-F9005 (serial not in manifest). We can split-ship replacements after approval. Return RMA: RX-223344.
Tom Crossdock: crossdock: apply tags `HOLD-QC` and `HOLD-SERIAL` to flagged units. If tags missing they'll be palletized. Also customs broker is asking for original commercial invoice; vendor emailed a corrected one but not the notarized copy. Could delay replacement by customs hold.
Maria Ops: propose partial-release 21 -> staging-FRA, hold 5 at crossdock. Canary uses 4 units; losing 3 DOA is risky. @Jordan check loaners and latency.
Jordan SCM: loaner pool: FRA has 1 A100 available, AMS has 2 (transit ~14h). Not sufficient for 3 DOA within test window. Recommend express replacement.
audit-bot: audit-bot: flagged vendor change: HS code updated on corrected invoice. Please ensure import EORI matches our account: FR-REDWOOD-001.
Maria Ops: vendor to confirm EORI on replacement AWB. Also need explicit prepaid RMA labels. If express cost < SLA exposure, approve. @finance-bot please advise quick.
finance-bot: finance-bot: express quote (€3,200) < estimated SLA risk. Approve up to €3,500. Charge center: INFRA-GPU-EU. Attach vendor invoice to cost ticket.
Elena (NordShip): scheduling express pickup now. Expected replacement AWB NS-EU-223344-R to post at ts 3623457000. ETA depot FRA 36-48h. Prepaid RMA labels RX-223344 included. Vendor confirms replacements will be un-imaged.
Tom Crossdock: applying holds and moving 21 units to `staging-fra-ready`. Manifest snippet uploaded:
```
unit,serial,location,status
A100,A100-F8001,staging-fra,ready
A100,A100-F8002,staging-fra,ready
...
A100,A100-F9001,crossdock-fra,hold-qc-doa
A100,A100-F9002,crossdock-fra,hold-qc-doa
A100,A100-F9003,crossdock-fra,hold-qc-doa
A100,A100-F9004,crossdock-fra,hold-serial-mismatch
A100,A100-F9005,crossdock-fra,hold-serial-mismatch
```
Maria Ops: crossdock instructed not to ship the 5 flagged units. SRE notified to run canary with reduced capacity and delay full rollout 24h. Thread will remain open until replacement AWB posts or customs reports an issue. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
